node.title: General local shift pairs partition exactly by locator-difference degree
node.statement: Let S and S0 be distinct same-depth-t locator-prefix A-subsets in any support-wise residual family. With C=S intersect S0, P=S\C, Q=S0\C, e=|P|=|Q|, and d=deg(L_P-L_Q), one has 0<=d<=e-t-1 and hence e>=t+d+1. Moreover d=0 if and only if e_j(P)=e_j(Q) for every 1<=j<=e-1, exactly the F-4 minimal constant-shift condition. Therefore every local same-prefix degree partitions disjointly into d=0 minimal records and d>=1 genuinely nonminimal records; the top side width e=t+1 is necessarily minimal. Primitive-scale restriction and support-wise first-owner deletion preserve the partition.
